threads.body:
The deprecation warning for the old `common.database` declarative config is using an internal-looking path string (e.g. `.instrumentation/development.java...`) that doesn’t match what users configure in YAML and is inconsistent with the repo guidance to reference user-facing config keys in warnings. Consider logging the actual YAML keys (e.g. `instrumentation/development: java: common: database: ...`) and/or the corresponding flat property name instead, so the warning is actionable.
```suggestion
          "instrumentation/development: java: common: database: sqlcommenter/development:"
              + " enabled",
          "instrumentation/development: java: common: db: sqlcommenter/development:"
              + " enabled");
```

Same issue as above: the warning strings passed here use an internal path format (leading `.` and mixed `.`/`/`) that isn’t what users write in declarative YAML. Please switch the logged deprecated/replacement identifiers to user-facing declarative keys and/or flat property names to make the warning actionable.
```suggestion
          "instrumentation.common.database.statement_sanitizer.enabled",
          "instrumentation.common.db.query_sanitization.enabled");
```

Typo/wording: "Takes precedent" should be "Takes precedence" (or "Takes precedence over"). Also remove the trailing whitespace before the line break to avoid noisy diffs.
```suggestion
    description: Enables query sanitization for database queries. Takes precedence over
```
